templates.label: Build a website
templates.description: Marketing site with hero, features, pricing, contact
templates.body:
Build a marketing website with:
- Hero section with a clear value proposition
- Three feature sections
- A pricing page with three tiers
- A contact form that emails me on submit
- Mobile-responsive

Stack: Next.js + Tailwind. Deploy target: Vercel.

templates.label: Build an API
templates.description: REST or GraphQL API with auth + persistence
templates.body:
Build a REST API for a [describe the domain] with:
- CRUD endpoints for the main resource
- Token-based authentication
- Persistence layer (SQLite via Drizzle)
- OpenAPI spec generated
- Tests for every endpoint

Stack: Fastify + Drizzle + Vitest.

templates.label: Write technical documentation
templates.description: Architecture docs, API docs, or user guides
templates.body:
Document this codebase with:
- A README that explains what it does in 3 paragraphs
- An ARCHITECTURE.md describing the major components and how they talk
- API reference for every public function
- A 'getting started' section with a working example

Tone: technical but warm. Audience: developers who'll inherit this.

templates.label: Audit security
templates.description: Review for OWASP top 10 + auth weaknesses + secret leaks
templates.body:
Audit this codebase for security issues. Specifically:
- OWASP top 10 — find any instances
- Secrets accidentally committed to history
- Auth/session weaknesses
- Input validation gaps
- Dependency vulnerabilities

Deliver a markdown report with severity ratings and concrete fixes.

templates.label: Design a UI
templates.body:
Design a UI for [describe the screen / feature]. I want:
- Two layout options to choose from
- One with a sidebar, one without
- Light + dark mode support
- Accessible (WCAG AA contrast)
- Implemented in React + Tailwind so I can copy-paste

Deliverable: a Storybook page with both options.

templates.label: Refactor existing code
templates.body:
Refactor [describe the module / file] for:
- Better separation of concerns
- Smaller functions (target: <30 lines each)
- Improved naming
- Test coverage where missing

Constraint: zero behavior changes. Every existing test must still pass.
